rationale: The agent did look up the user by email and fetched order details, and it initiated returns apparently to the original payment methods. However, it executed return actions without first confirming with the user which items to return, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing write. It also did not provide final information (e.g., refund amounts/timelines, return labels or next steps). Authentication beyond a lookup is unclear, and acting only on the user’s orders is not explicitly verified in the conversation. Given these gaps, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
